Chat through a locally installed Claude CLI

Source: R/api_claude_cli.R
claude_cli.Rd

claude_cli() routes a chat to the claude command line tool installed on your own machine, using the login it already has. It takes no API key. See claude_cli_chat() for the arguments and for what happens to the CLI's own file and shell tools.

Usage

claude_cli(..., .called_from = NULL)

Arguments

...

Arguments passed to the CLI chat function.

.called_from

Internal; the verb that dispatched here.

Value

The result of the requested action; for chat(), an updated LLMMessage.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
llm_message("Explain R's S7 classes in three sentences.") |>
  chat(claude_cli())
} # }
